$comment: Project-level bindings for role checks: which command decides each claim in THIS repo. A check with no binding is judged by the model and graded inferential.

tests-red.receipt: the failing test names and their assertion messages, pasted

tests-untouched.receipt: exit 0 means no test file differs from HEAD; on a non-zero exit, run the diff to see which files

canon-drift.receipt: the line 'canon check: OK' or the failure list

adr-numbering.receipt: no 'ADR numbering' line in the failure list

dependency-audit.receipt: exit 0: uv.lock matches pyproject (resolved under exclude-newer). No CVE scanner is wired yet, so CVE claims stay inferential.

disagreement-rate.receipt: the rate line: N items, M non-unanimous; exit 1 only on a full window with rate 0

line-respected.receipt: the summary line; a violation names the item, stations, and instance

ci-green.run: node scripts/check-canon.mjs && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest -q
ci-green.receipt: 'canon check: OK', ruff 'All checks passed!', and the pytest summary line

negative-control.receipt: the control line and the verdict per lens (verdicts are information; presence is the claim)

installs-and-builds.receipt: the last line of uv's output

product-context-present.receipt: exit 0; fails until /kickoff or the product seat fills docs/product-context.md
